market.advice: Into the open: SPY closed 757.67, right at a 52-week high, above both its 50-DMA (744.59) and 200-DMA (697.91), up 2.5% on the week. VIX is 15.7 and falling against a 17.1 five-day average, there is only 1 distribution day on the board and a follow-through day has printed. The Dow closed at a record on optimism that the US-Iran talks produce a deal. So the index is healthy — but do not read the index and stop there, because QQQ closed at 700.07 BELOW its 50-DMA. That gap is the whole story. Of the 523 names scanned, 191 rate STRONG BUY, and the leadership is banks, insurers, REITs, rails, aerospace, refiners, distributors and staples. The semiconductor complex is in a genuine drawdown — AMAT is 28% off its high, LRCX 32%, MU 32%, AMKR 46%, MXL 48%, SNDK 45%, and NXPI printed an RSI of 17.8 — and high-beta momentum is worse (COIN -62%, RGTI -72%, LUNR -71%, RKLB -53%, APP -45%, HOOD -41%, PLTR -39%, TSLA -34%). But this is not 'sell all tech': AMZN, SNOW, NTAP and GRMN all closed at new 52-week highs, and DDOG, ANET, DLR and FTNT sit within 2% of theirs. The AI trade has narrowed to the names with visible cash flow and away from the story stocks. Two cautions. First, breadth is only moderate — 60% of the universe is above its 50-DMA, not the 70%+ that marks a broad advance — and the leaderboard below is heavily financials and REITs, which is one macro bet on rates and credit wearing a dozen tickers; size them as one position, not twelve. Second, an unusual earnings wall lands inside 72 hours: ROK, AME, GWW, KIM and DOCN report TODAY; ANET, EOG, DVA, AIZ, IRM, MTCH, LLY, ALAB, AMD and SPCX tomorrow; HWM, DDOG, MET, APA, TRNO, WDC, SNDK and APP the day after; AFL, RGA, ABNB and MNST on the 7th. Anything reporting inside three days is a WATCH here, not a buy. And the Iran rally is one headline deep — Trump paired the negotiation with a public 'decapitation' threat, so a failed round gaps energy up and everything else down at once.
market.sizing: Normal size on the un-extended value/cyclical/REIT leaders with earnings 30+ days out. Half size or wait on anything reporting inside three days. No new money into the broken semiconductor or high-beta complex until a base actually forms — a 40% drawdown is not a setup. Cap total financials + REIT exposure as a single macro position.
